title: 1.10 Pets
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Name a dog, a cat, a bird and a rabbit, say they are pets, and say what they are doing.
grammar_function: Un/Una + animal; El + animal + está + action; El + animal + es una mascota (mascota is always feminine); Son mascotas.
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.9: people, family, articles, es/está, son/están.
speaking_outcome: Name the pets and say what they are doing.
